title: Bind canonical roster, Plant bootstrap, and multi-provider Agent Runtime
verify: Roster tests prove version 1 contains exactly the eight ordered canonical ids, display names, competence summaries, introduction texts, output-schema seam, and owning-feature mappings from the canonical contract; activation alone does not make an unimplemented owning-feature policy invocable.

Configuration tests atomically reject malformed JSON, unknown fields/agent ids/profiles, blank or unsafe model ids, credential-bearing values, and caller overrides; partial bindings are allowed but invocation of an unbound agent fails before provider construction.

DeepSeek and Gemini factory tests construct their native Agno model adapters with the exact deployment model id and declared direct dependencies; missing dependency/key/egress or provider failure never selects another provider/model or fake output.

The chatgpt_oauth profile is recognized but returns AGENT_RUNTIME_NOT_CONFIGURED without an approved injected broker; production code does not read ChatGPT browser/Codex credential stores, substitute OPENAI_API_KEY, or claim the profile is operational.

Outbound provider-spy snapshots match the sole strict ProviderRequestV1 and canonical AgentInputRecordV1 order exactly; no ActorContext, account/membership/role/grant/session provenance, provider selection, credential, raw chat/UI, timeline replay, hidden reasoning, unapproved governance, provider history, or local path is sent.

Plant-create integration preserves the canonical request schema, active Boss/Engineer authorization, same-transaction Plant/grant/audit atomicity, 201 PlantSummary, Cache-Control no-store, and full existing error mapping. Bootstrap starts only after commit, never changes the selected HTTP result, and makes no provider call.

UUID tests use namespace ddbb4fc1-7253-5953-a427-9693caeafd80 and exact UTF-8 names `batch:v1:<plant_id>:<roster_version>` and `introduction:v1:<plant_id>:<agent_id>:<roster_version>` with lowercase UUIDs and unpadded base-10 roster version.

Bootstrap calls AgentIntroductionSink.store_batch exactly once with one strict ordered eight-item batch. Result tests cover only accepted(true,8,null), identical duplicate(true,8,null), rejected(false,0,plant_not_publishable|batch_invalid|content_conflict), and failed(false,0,persistence_failed); per-item or partial acceptance is impossible.

Roster eligibility is derived from the current active Plant plus immutable roster version, survives process restart without a per-Plant registry table, and is unavailable for missing, wrong-Farm, or archived Plants.

Bootstrap retry produces identical batch/item ids and canonical content; sink rejected/failed leaves the Plant committed and cannot report rollback/500. No FT-007 path implements FT-008 storage, worker, reconciliation, UIFeedEvent projection, or durable/visible success without a concrete downstream sink.

A credentialed non-skipped DeepSeek or Gemini smoke uses the isolated test-only runtime_contract_smoke definition/binding through production assembler/provider composition, actual persisted Plant plus check-in or pH/EC evidence, and exactly one real provider. It passes only with audited envelope_ready plus a valid pending MessageEnvelope or strict audited model_silent with no_material_output|insufficient_evidence; context_denied, runtime_not_configured, provider_failed, output_invalid, publication_guard_denied, audit_failed, skip, xfail, fake, fallback, or unaudited output fails.
Behavior specs FT-007-BHV-001 through FT-007-BHV-003 have direct executable traceability; the introduction behavior is not counted as real-model evidence.
Independent /verify and task-level /red-verify complete before lifecycle closure; feature-level /red-verify --feature FT-007 remains the later feature boundary gate.
evidence_required: strict binding parser and no caller/default/fallback evidence
native DeepSeek and Gemini constructor/dependency evidence
fail-closed ChatGPT OAuth and forbidden credential-store scan
typed external-egress allowlist and credential/log redaction evidence
post-commit Plant bootstrap plus unchanged request/auth/201/no-store/atomic/error evidence
exact UUIDv5 namespace/name and one-call ordered batch snapshot
closed 8-or-0 sink result, deterministic retry, conflict, and no-partial evidence
truthful FT-008 ownership and no durable/visible-chat overclaim evidence
credentialed non-skipped real-provider smoke summary with accepted audited outcome and safe model ref
focused Plant-create/Agent Runtime and full regression summaries
purpose: Complete FT-007 production composition with stable product-agent identities, explicit multi-provider bindings, post-commit Plant activation, and real-provider anti-cheat evidence.
success_outcome: Without changing the public Plant-create contract, every committed active Plant can submit one deterministic eight-item non-agent-consumable batch through the strict 8-or-0 sink port, each enabled canonical agent resolves only its explicit deployment provider/model, and a real DeepSeek or Gemini returns one accepted audited FT-007 smoke outcome while ChatGPT OAuth and every unavailable/failed path fail closed without fallback or hidden FT-008 work.
anti_goals: No BusEventEnvelope, durable chat/UI Feed storage, context reconstruction, worker, outbox, frontend, or FT-008 task implementation.
No eight model invocations merely because a Plant was created and no long-lived per-Plant agent processes.
No detailed Vision, Plant State, Advisor, Safety Gate, Task, Companion, Dataset Governance, or Curator product effects beyond stable roster identity and competence metadata.
No default/hardcoded model id, credential-driven selection, provider/model fallback, fake response, or provider history persistence.
No undocumented ChatGPT OAuth exchange, ChatGPT browser/Codex credential reuse, or API-key substitution mislabeled as OAuth.

forbidden_scope: Bus, chat/UI Feed persistence, context queries, worker, outbox, frontend, or FT-008 tasking
new PostgreSQL agent-run, provider-history, prompt, or introduction-delivery tables
detailed downstream agent competence effects or product triggers
hardcoded/default model ids or cross-provider/model fallback
ChatGPT browser/Codex credential access or undocumented OAuth implementation
unredacted credential, auth, provider, path, raw chat, or hidden-reasoning evidence
stop_conditions: TASK-028-T3-FT-007-W1 is not complete or its strict runtime/envelope contract is contradicted.
No explicit DeepSeek or Gemini smoke profile/model id, matching credential, and external-egress opt-in are available when the mandatory closure smoke is attempted; do not skip or fake it.
Operational ChatGPT OAuth is demanded without an approved broker contract defining token source, refresh/expiry, revocation, endpoint/audience, redaction, and smoke path.
Automatic Plant bootstrap would require holding the Plant transaction over provider/network I/O or falsely returning a rollback after commit.
The hook cannot preserve the canonical POST /api/plants request, authorization, 201 PlantSummary, no-store, atomic commit, or error contract.
The downstream port cannot represent one atomic eight-item accepted-or-zero result without per-item partial success.
Correctness would require implementing durable chat/feed delivery, Bus/UI context, worker/outbox, or any FT-008 task under this card.
Diagnostics or evidence contain credentials, session/auth material, raw provider payload, hidden reasoning, raw chat, unapproved governance content, or local absolute paths.

constraints: Implement one immutable roster version with the exact eight ids, order, competence/introduction metadata, output-schema seam, and owning-feature mappings; callers cannot add or override roster records.
Parse one strict non-secret AGENT_MODEL_BINDINGS_JSON mapping and require AGENT_EXTERNAL_EGRESS_ENABLED=true before external provider construction.
Declare direct Agno, DeepSeek/OpenAI-compatible, and Gemini google-genai dependencies and construct only the explicitly selected native adapter/model id.
Keep chatgpt_oauth as a recognized injected broker port that is unavailable by default; never discover credentials or reinterpret API-key auth.

Preserve the complete Plant Management HTTP and Farm/Plant/Access Storage contract; invoke bootstrap only after commit and never turn sink rejection/failure into rollback, false 500, or a changed PlantSummary.
Derive batch/item UUIDv5 ids with namespace ddbb4fc1-7253-5953-a427-9693caeafd80 and the exact canonical name strings, then call one strict eight-item sink batch.
Accept only the closed AgentIntroductionBatchResultV1 8-or-0 matrix; duplicate requires identical canonical content and partial acceptance is invalid.
Register the pytest real_model marker in project test configuration so deterministic and credentialed suites select tests without unknown-marker ambiguity.
Require a credentialed non-skipped DeepSeek or Gemini smoke over actual persisted non-Plant-only context before this task can close.
invariants: Provider/auth mode/model binding is project configuration, never caller or model output.
A provider/model failure cannot change identity, competence, provider, model, or produce a fake fallback.
Only authorized typed Plant context may leave the process; secrets, auth material, raw chat/UI, provider history, and hidden reasoning never do.
Plant creation activation is deterministic metadata handoff, not model execution, MessageEnvelope, agent working context, or REQ-011 evidence.
Committed Plant state is not rolled back or misreported after a post-commit bootstrap/sink failure.
Visible/durable introduction delivery, active-Plant reconciliation, and exactly-once UIFeedEvent projection remain FT-008 authority and are not implemented or overclaimed by FT-007.
Only audited envelope_ready or strict audited model_silent can pass the credentialed smoke; no failure branch is synthetic silence.
verification_targets: Run static scans for test/canned/fallback executors, hardcoded model ids, OPENAI_API_KEY substitution, Codex/ChatGPT credential paths, provider request/response persistence, and hidden FT-008 storage/worker/projection code.
Trace FT-007-BHV-001 through FT-007-BHV-003 to concrete passing tests, assert the exact accepted smoke outcomes, and distinguish deterministic introduction metadata from real-model evidence.
